children.title: UralicNLP
children.description: A Python library for processing Uralic languages (Finnish, Skolt Sami, Erzya, Moksha, Komi-Zyrian and so on). The library provides an easy programmatic access to Giellatekno resources such as FST morphology and CG disambiguators. Other functionalities include UD parser, API for the Online Dictionary of Uralic Languages and interface to SemFi and SemUr semantic databases. The library is under active development and new features are added from time to time.

repo_info.description: An NLP library for Uralic languages such as Finnish, Skolt Sami, Moksha and so on. Also supporting some non-Uralic languages such as Spanish, French, Arabic, Swedish, Norwegian, Russian and English. LLMs, FSTs and More!
